### UPDATE 2026-11-22 JST — Optional Win10-compatible HeapWalk REGION commit discriminator implemented, fresh Combo16 CI pending

- **New API-based falsifiable candidate:** Microsoft [PROCESS_HEAP_ENTRY](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/minwinbase/ns-minwinbase-process_heap_entry) permits `PROCESS_HEAP_REGION` with `Region.dwCommittedSize` (busy + free + heap control); unlike allocated `entry.cbData`, this reports some heap committed capacity. The field is **optional** (zero if not supplied) and *some large allocations have no REGION entry*. Thus its sum is partial even if all observed regions are known; never describe it as full process committed memory. `HeapWalk`/`HeapLock` APIs predate Windows10, unlike the newer OS-dependent `HeapSummary` API. No `HeapCompact` or heap mutation will be used on real recorder.
